anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

anchors.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, a data structure standard for organizing MEG data, which is a technical specification/methodology used for data sharing, not a paper introducing the MEG-SCANS dataset.

metadata.methods_description: Magnetoencephalography recordings were collected from 24 participants over three months during auditory experiments. Each session included approximately one hour of stimuli: two audiobooks (~20 minutes each), 120 sentences from the Oldenburger Matrix Sentence Test (OLSA) at varying speech intelligibility levels (20-95%) for Speech Reception Threshold assessment, and short up-chirps for MEG signal quality assessment. Auxiliary channels recorded left audio (MISC001), right audio (MISC002), and instructor microphone (MISC007) at 1000 Hz. Empty-room MEG recordings were acquired pre- and post-session. Structural MRI scans and behavioral hearing assessments including audiograms were obtained for each participant.
